sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','p','O') and 20<n['pixels']<200:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols)))
    return out
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':46}])   # brush orange
action(['SPACE'])                               # top 5 rows orange -> bottom all orange
print("mid:", blocks(current_frame), last_action_result.get('state'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
if not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':40}])   # brush purple
    print("final:", blocks(current_frame), last_action_result.get('state'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
